# python-hwpx

> Pure-Python library for reading, editing, and creating HWPX documents (the
> Korean word-processor format used by Hancom Office / 한컴오피스 한글). HWPX is
> ZIP + OWPML XML, so no Hancom installation is needed — works on
> Windows/macOS/Linux/CI and inside Python-enabled chat sandboxes. Untouched
> ZIP parts are preserved according to the requested save grade; generated files were
> verified to open in real Hancom Office over a frozen corpus (measured
> 2026-07-19 — the published corpus metrics page carries the exact
> measurement stack and date). Install: `pip install python-hwpx` (Python 3.10–3.14, only
> dependency is lxml). License: Apache-2.0.

Use the API paths below rather than inferring names from python-docx.

## Core API (memorize these exact names)

- `from hwpx import HwpxDocument` — the document facade.
- Open: `HwpxDocument.open("file.hwpx")` (path, bytes, or file object; usable
  as a context manager). New: `HwpxDocument.new()`.
- Save a new document: `document.save_to_path("out.hwpx")` (default mode: auto).
  For strict preservation of an existing document, use a distinct output path:
  `document.save_to_path("out.hwpx", mode="patch", fallback="error", return_report=True)`.
  An unavailable patch grade raises `PreservationDowngradeError` before writing.
  Auto selects the achievable grade; it does not promise patch preservation.
  `MutationReport` records the actual save and checks performed. Its `ok` does
  not prove the requested edit was applied or that visual verification ran.
- Edit: `document.add_heading(text, level=1)`, `document.add_paragraph(text)`,
  `paragraph.remove()` (last paragraph in a section raises `ValueError`),
  `document.add_table(rows, cols)`
  then `table.set_cell_text(row, col, text)`,
  `document.notes.add_footnote(text, paragraph=p)`,
  `document.notes.add_memo(text, anchor=p, memo_shape_id_ref="0")` (returns a
  Memo with `paragraph` and `field_id` attributes, not a tuple),
  `document.text.replace(search, replacement)` (returns count; empty search
  raises `ValueError`). Replacement is within individual body runs, not across
  run boundaries or nested table paragraphs. Check the expected replacement
  count before saving; zero replacements are not task completion.
- Read: `document.paragraphs`, `paragraph.text`, `document.sections`,
  `document.text.runs()`, `document.notes.memos`, `document.fields.all()`.
- Tables: `document.tables.find_cell_by_label(label)` returns all matches;
  a merged cell counts once, and a direction crosses its full span. Separate
  physical cells with the same label remain ambiguous.
  `document.tables.fill_by_path({"성명 > right": "홍길동"})` returns `applied`
  and `failed` lists and their counts. Check every requested entry before
  saving: ambiguous labels are failures, and other entries may have changed
  in memory. Reopen the output and check the intended values.
- Forms: `document.fields.add(name, prompt=...)` creates a native
  click-here field (real-Hancom CLICKHERE contract; experimental tier);
  `document.fields.fill(value, name=...)` returns a FieldFillResult with
  `before` and `after` attributes; failure raises an exception.
- Equations: `document.shapes.add_equation(script)` inserts a native
  `<hp:equation>` from a Hancom EqEdit script (experimental tier);
  `from hwpx.equation import latex_to_eqedit` converts LaTeX to EqEdit over a
  render-verified token set and raises `UnsupportedLatexError` outside it —
  no silent approximation.
- Extract: `from hwpx import TextExtractor` →
  `TextExtractor("file.hwpx").extract_text()`;
  `iter_document_paragraphs(include_nested=True)` yields `ParagraphInfo` with
  `.path` (structural location) and `.is_nested`. Footnotes/endnotes:
  `extract_text(include_nested=False, annotations=AnnotationOptions(footnote="inline"))`
  with `from hwpx.tools.text_extractor import AnnotationOptions`.
- Structural search: `from hwpx import ObjectFinder` →
  `ObjectFinder("file.hwpx").find_all(tag="tbl")`; results have `.path`,
  `.section`, `.text` (attribute; `None` on container elements).
- Validate: `from hwpx import validate_package, validate_editor_open_safety`.

## Unavailable document APIs

- `document.save()` does not exist. Use `save_to_path` or `save_to_stream`.

## Common mistakes to avoid
- `.hwp` (HWP 5.x binary) is a different format: opening raises `BadZipFile`
  with guidance. Encrypted HWPX is rejected fail-closed.
- All `add_*` calls append (not idempotent); check existence first by
  traversal when you need "add once".
- Report content verification, untouched-part preservation, package/open-safety
  checks, reopen and visual verification separately. `visual="not_performed"`
  must remain unverified; it is not a visual pass. Untouched ZIP parts alone
  do not establish preservation inside a modified part or unchanged layout.
- Higher-level workflows (institution-specific form filling, exam papers, mail merge
  policy, `hwpx` CLI, MCP server, Hancom render verification) live in the
  companion package `python-hwpx-automation` (import `hwpx_automation`), not
  in the core library.

## Docs

- [Five-minute quickstart](https://airmang.github.io/python-hwpx/quickstart.html):
  install → open → read → edit → table → save with receipt.
- [Traversal recipes](https://airmang.github.io/python-hwpx/recipes-traversal.html):
  paragraphs, nested tables with paths, footnote extraction, runs, memos.
- [Mutation semantics](https://airmang.github.io/python-hwpx/mutation-semantics.html):
  return types, failure modes, re-run behavior, save guarantees.
- [Support matrix](https://airmang.github.io/python-hwpx/support-matrix.html):
  honest per-capability grades (what is render-verified vs unsupported —
  e.g., form-field, equation, chart, and check-box creation are
  experimental-tier supported; radio buttons and command buttons are
  read/preserve only).
- [Safe write contract](https://airmang.github.io/python-hwpx/safe-write-contract.html):
  preservation grades and the `MutationReport` schema.
- [API migration](https://airmang.github.io/python-hwpx/migration-6.0.html):
  current namespaces, return objects and deprecated facade replacements.
- [Corpus metrics](https://airmang.github.io/python-hwpx/corpus-metrics.html):
  measured open/render rates on real Hancom Office.
- [API reference](https://airmang.github.io/python-hwpx/api_reference.html)
- [GitHub](https://github.com/airmang/python-hwpx) ·
  [PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/python-hwpx/)
